sizing_rules.fractional_equivalent: Theoretical exact allocation and half exits; fractional contracts are not executable.
sizing_rules.whole_even_contracts: Largest affordable even quantity, minimum two; sell exactly half at TP1.
sizing_rules.whole_contracts_keep_runner: Largest affordable integer quantity, minimum one; sell floor(quantity/2) at TP1 and keep the remainder on the paper runner exit.
sizing_rules.whole_contracts_sell_odd_at_tp1: Largest affordable integer quantity, minimum one; sell ceil(quantity/2) at TP1 and keep the remainder on the paper runner exit.

limitations: Model prices and estimated fees/slippage, without real option quotes, fills or verified listings.
Fractional-equivalent sizing is theoretical; even whole lots require at least two contracts for half exits.
One-contract modes allow any affordable integer quantity; odd lots require the stated TP1 rounding rule.
Early account exits keep their original paper scheduler slots and do not create replacement trades.
Unfunded account orders retain their paper scheduler slots and do not create replacement alerts.
Drawdowns use minute-close modeled net liquidation including estimated remaining closing costs.
All additional slippage scenarios are beyond the existing model spread assumption.

cash_only.valuation_basis: Listed contract membership with Black-Scholes model prices; not executable option quotes or fills.
limitations: Initial account equity is assumed to be fully settled modeled cash, not a verified broker balance.
Catalog membership does not establish liquidity, broker approval or execution price.
Missing, future or older-than-24-hour catalog observations are never replaced with synthetic listings.
Option pricing uses theoretical IV/delta and actual listed expiries/strikes; historical fills remain unverified.
T+1 settlement excludes market closures and Columbus/Veterans bank holidays; actual broker release is not verified.
P1A-only signals use minute-close management, not the old intrabar exit simulation.
